slices.title: HTML source to visible pixels
slices.status: Static pipeline implemented
slices.limitation: This path lacks complete CSS, forms, DOM scripting and a GPU backend.

slices.title: Navigation and retained layout
slices.status: Initial implementation
slices.limitation: No full History API or single-page-application lifecycle.

slices.title: Author CSS to painted box
slices.status: Partial CSS
slices.limitation: CSS cascade, first-line and some grouping exist; many CSS properties and layout modes remain partial.

slices.title: Color-managed image to GDI
slices.status: Implemented initial raster/ICC slice
slices.limitation: Windows WIC performs codec/color conversion; OPBrowser owns resource policy and paint.

slices.title: Original JavaScript engine boundary
slices.status: Standalone VM with first bounded page DOM binding
slices.limitation: Classic inline and bounded same-origin external scripts now update textContent by id. Async/defer, document.write, module scripts and full DOM/Web APIs remain unsupported.

slices.title: Classic inline JavaScript to retained DOM and pixels
slices.status: M4.6 parser-paused classic page script slice
slices.limitation: Bounded classic execution at script closing tags during DOM construction; basic external scripts now exist but no event loop, general DOM mutations or full HTML5test support.

slices.title: External classic JavaScript through filtered network to DOM
slices.status: M4.6 parser-paused same-origin external JS
slices.limitation: Only relative/local and same-origin HTTP(S) classic scripts in source order at parser pauses. Redirect origin checked after retrieval; async/defer/integrity not supported, no browser event loop.

slices.title: Native Win32 click through bubbling DOM listeners to repainted DOM
slices.status: M4.5 capture-target-bubble and cancellation events
slices.limitation: Only id-bearing block regions; capture/target/bubbling and listener cancellation work, but keyboard/default actions and full DOM hit-testing remain absent.

slices.title: Parser-closing classic script through retained DOM
slices.status: M4.6 parser-paused classic scripting
slices.limitation: Eager tokenization; no document.write reentry, module scripts, independent async event loop or DOM lifecycle events.

slices.title: Bounded defer and async classic JavaScript scheduling
slices.status: M4.7 concurrent source fetch with parser polling
slices.limitation: Concurrent fetch and initial-load JS polling only; no event loop, DOMContentLoaded, module scripts or SRI.

slices.title: Page readyState and DOMContentLoaded/load lifecycle to paint
slices.status: M4.8 initial-load DOM lifecycle subset
slices.limitation: Initial-load-only readyState and DOMContentLoaded/load; timers and microtasks exist separately but no Promise or post-presentation async fetch.

slices.title: Retained JavaScript one-shot timeout to native reflow
slices.status: M4.9 bounded page-owned timer tasks
slices.limitation: Bounded timeout/interval and queueMicrotask jobs now exist; no Promise jobs, network event tasks or background throttling.

slices.title: Repeating timers and FIFO microtask checkpoints to native paint
slices.status: M4.10 bounded intervals and VM microtasks
slices.limitation: Intervals and bounded FIFO microtasks; no Promise resolution jobs or network tasks after initial page paint.

slices.title: Nonstandard text IO callback after first native paint
slices.status: M4.11 page-scoped filtered network completion tasks
slices.limitation: Nonstandard callback IO only, same-origin/64 KiB/8 requests; no Promise, fetch, CORS, streams or cancellation.

slices.title: Self-hosted Promise and fetch text GET to native pixels
slices.status: M4.12 bounded same-origin Promise/Response text GET
slices.limitation: Self-hosted Promise reactions, same-origin GET, synthetic 200/OK text-only Response; HTTP failures reject, no CORS, headers, streaming or abort.

slices.title: HTTP response metadata through own JS Headers to native pixels
slices.status: M4.13 GET status and headers metadata
slices.limitation: Bounded same-origin GET text; status/reason/headers/final URL with Set-Cookie hidden. No CORS, streams or public Headers constructor.

slices.title: Request Headers and guarded pre-connect redirect flow
slices.status: M4.14 bounded GET request fields and origin checks
slices.limitation: Same-origin GET text only, restricted request headers and <=5 checked redirect hops; no CORS, stream, credentials or POST.

slices.title: JSON parser through Promise reactions to native repaint
slices.status: M4.15 bounded JSON and array-like Promise combinators
slices.limitation: Bounded JSON parse/serialize, array-like combinators; no toJSON/reviver/replacer or true iterable protocol.

slices.title: Original VM object/environment allocation observability before garbage collection
slices.status: M4.35 non-collecting heap_usage diagnostic and explicit GC design
slices.limitation: Append-only arenas; diagnostic counts include unreachable slots; no collection, no long-session memory plateau.

slices.title: Parser documentElement and pre-dispatch propagation through original WPT
slices.status: M4.35 pinned original WPT DOM/Events v8 21/21 attempted PASS 3 SKIP
slices.limitation: Narrow pinned original synchronous WPT selection; not representative DOM/Event/visual readiness.

slices.title: Real pinned WPT Events source through original Function.call and native render verdict
slices.status: M4.34 original v7 16/16 selected attempted PASS, 3 explicit SKIP
slices.limitation: Manually selected synchronous WPT smoke only; 19 pinned files, 16 attempted, 3 explicit SKIP; not full conformance.

slices.title: Original EventTarget constructor and handleEvent listeners to native paint
slices.status: M4.33a-b standalone EventTarget, shared prototype and callback object delivery
slices.limitation: Bounded original EventTarget prototype and callback objects; no full WebIDL descriptors, Event subclasses, Shadow DOM or broad pinned WPT Events conformance.

slices.title: Trusted original layout-hit-tested click versus programmatic Element.click through native pixels
slices.status: M4.32b original click trust marker and EventInit.composed/readonly flags
slices.limitation: Light-DOM events only; no Shadow DOM retargeting, trusted default activation, WebIDL property descriptors or broad WPT Events conformance.

slices.title: Event composedPath and cancelBubble during original DOM dispatch through native paint
slices.status: M4.32a active event path snapshots, cleanup and legacy propagation alias
slices.limitation: Bounded connected light-DOM paths only; no Shadow DOM composed retargeting, full Event WebIDL descriptors or broad WPT Events conformance.

slices.title: Chronological onclick and lifecycle property handler delivery to original native paint
slices.status: M4.31 owned EventTarget property slots share normal registration order
slices.limitation: Bounded original property handler ordering; no complete WHATWG EventTarget/HTML activation or broad WPT Events coverage.

slices.title: Stable EventTarget callback registration identity through original DOM/native paint
slices.status: M4.31 listener tokens distinguish a removed/readded function during dispatch
slices.limitation: Original JS function callbacks only; no listener object interface or full WPT/DOM EventTarget conformance.

slices.title: AbortSignal cancels Promise fetch queues and late network callbacks to original paint
slices.status: M4.30c-d original native-signal fetch rejection and late network suppression
slices.limitation: Buffered same-origin GET; JS callbacks canceled and late completions dropped but blocking WinHTTP work may finish; no streaming, CORS or non-GET.

slices.title: DOMException AbortSignal timeout/any composition via page-owned task loop
slices.status: M4.30b-d original DOMException, bounded timeout scheduler and signal followers
slices.limitation: No generic iterable AbortSignal.any, timeout >60 seconds, or broad WebIDL DOMException conformance.

slices.title: AbortController signal listener cancellation through original DOM and native paint
slices.status: M4.30a bounded native AbortController/AbortSignal and listener options.signal
slices.limitation: No DOMException default reason, AbortSignal.timeout/any, signal cancellation of fetch/timers, or broad WPT Events conformance.

slices.title: Connected Element event capture/target/bubble through document/window to native paint
slices.status: M4.29b bounded original Element global propagation and native click handling
slices.limitation: 64-element ancestry budget, no Shadow DOM, default activation, AbortSignal or broad WPT conformance.

slices.title: Document/window lifecycle and custom EventTarget through original native paint
slices.status: M4.29a original document/window listener options, dispatchEvent and error isolation
slices.limitation: Element event paths do not yet include document/window; no AbortSignal or official asynchronous WPT harness.

slices.title: Element event listener once/passive error isolation to native pixels
slices.status: M4.28b bounded original Element addEventListener options and diagnostics
slices.limitation: Element listener dictionaries only. No AbortSignal or document/window options, official async WPT harness or broad event conformance.

slices.title: Immediate event propagation stop through native DOM pixels
slices.status: M4.28a bounded stopImmediatePropagation in original JS
slices.limitation: Immediate-stop control only; once/passive and listener exception isolation remain incomplete. External WPT baseline unchanged.

slices.title: Compound DOM selector chains and typed Event dispatch to native repaint
slices.status: M4.27 bounded original selectors and EventTarget with pinned WPT Events v5
slices.limitation: Bounded partial Selectors and EventTarget only; pinned WPT DOM/Events v5 is 12 chosen attempted/pass and 3 skips, not a conformance rate.

slices.title: JS in and scoped DOM selectors with programmatic click to native repaint
slices.status: M4.26 original VM selectors and event dispatch with WPT DOM v4
slices.limitation: Partial in, simple selectors, static query lists, bounded click only. 11 pinned manually chosen WPT files pass; 3 SKIP. Not full WPT.

slices.title: Live DOM tag search and pinned multi-test WPT DOM smoke to native pixels
slices.status: M4.25 bounded tag collection and fail-sticky testharness shim
slices.limitation: Ten manually selected original source WPT fixtures, 11 test callbacks, 3 skips; partial live tag collections, not full DOM.

slices.title: Live HTMLCollection and original pinned WPT DOM fixtures through native pixels
slices.status: M4.24 limited WPT DOM smoke v2 and retained Element.children
slices.limitation: Seven manually scoped real WPT DOM fixtures, three explicit skips; no official WPT compliance score.

slices.title: Pinned upstream WPT DOM fixture through original JS and native paint
slices.status: M4.23 fixed original WPT file with scoped synchronous harness adapter
slices.limitation: Exactly one original upstream WPT file attempted; limited harness, three explicit skips, not a full WPT score.

slices.title: Live NodeList and DOMTokenList style mutations to native pixels
slices.status: M4.22 retained JS DOM references, ordered operations and CSS recascade
slices.limitation: Limited bounded live NodeList, DOMTokenList and CSSStyleDeclaration only, not broad WPT DOM/CSSOM compliance.

slices.title: DOM removal and attributes trigger style recascade and native paint
slices.status: M4.21 actual DOM and CSS update
slices.limitation: Initial bounded DOM subset, not full WPT or CSSOM.

slices.title: DOM element creation and attachment through original VM to native paint
slices.status: M4.20 original VM pending DOM operations and authoritative tree
slices.limitation: Initial bounded createElement/appendChild/id/textContent only, with missing general DOM methods.

slices.title: Native standard String and Array methods to DOM text repaint
slices.status: M4.19 original VM builtins / SyntaxError
slices.limitation: Existing text DOM only; no insertion, lone UTF-16 surrogates or generic array-like methods.

slices.title: Page script typeof and ternary through native DOM repaint
slices.status: M4.18 original JS syntax and standard static helpers
slices.limitation: No complete modern ECMAScript, DOM or test harness support; v2 65/179 attempted with 110 explicit SKIP.

slices.title: Browser page boxed primitive and ToPrimitive to native paint
slices.status: M4.17 implemented; Test262 Runtime v1 82/91
slices.limitation: 91-case legacy arithmetic/equality suite; no strict mode, eval, Date, Symbol, or modern ES full semantics.

slices.title: WPT image comparison and reporting
slices.status: Strict and opt-in fuzzy reports
slices.limitation: Strict Static: 197/200; metadata-aware Static: 198/200; two Rec.2020 fixtures remain known mismatches.
